# Ownership evaluation admission protocol v1

This protocol adds a finite isolated evaluation phase. It does not redefine the acceptance criteria, grant operational authority, or mark a campaign complete.

## Immutable obligations and acyclic identity order

1. Preserve the original source package, candidate, contract, criteria definitions, frozen oracles and semantic decisions. The obligation set references these exact objects and retains all final duties. Its status is PENDING_FINAL_EVIDENCE.
2. Fix the evaluation plan: source materialization, finite consumer IDs and per-case modes/read limits, maintenance controls, semantic applicability and limitations per entry, isolated root and implementation pins. It contains no reserved answers.
3. Compute the plan and obligation-set CAS identities. Compute each admission contract from these references and the four separately defined ADMIT criteria. Contracts never refer to the new candidate.
4. Compute the complete candidate from actual inputs/results/dependencies, source observations, plan, contracts and executing runtime identity. No decision, receipt or manifest is in this preimage.
5. Fix a generation independently of objects that will reference it. For initial admission it may be chosen after the candidate. For rebuild it must be fixed before the target plan, which includes it.
6. Obtain two new distinct exact admission decisions for the complete candidate and every required entry. Decisions bind contract, input/dependency hash and result. They are not final AC verdicts.
7. Persist reviews from those exact decisions, then receipts, artifacts and manifest. Each v2 authority envelope is evaluation-only and binds the plan/obligations; all except contracts additionally bind candidate. The manifest binds generation. No backward hash dependency is introduced.

Changed source, membership, recipe, result authority, validity, gaps, applicability or implementation creates new identities and invalidates affected proofs. Equal prose does not imply equal result identity. Historical semantic evidence is never silently converted into a new admission decision.

## Isolation and real readers

Prepare is CAS-only. Initialization is explicit and refuses a pre-existing active/staged store, policy or descriptor. The evaluation source root cannot be the original root, an ancestor or its descendant. Mutable state cannot use symlinks or hardlink aliases. A marker records canonical root/device/inode, original root and CAS-only initialization. Policy is a separate strict versioned document, bound to exact plan/candidate/generation/scope, actor, operations and optional finite consumer case. The marker is not itself permission.

Operational composition defaults to refusal on evaluation stores. The existing composed ownership reader and governed writer remain the only serving/admission path. The closed ownership predicate slot is retained, with a distinct evaluation-only claim bound to candidate identity. Manifest/contract/receipt/review v2 discriminants, not the spelling of a path or claim alone, enforce the phase.

Selection and attachment verify exact candidate mapping and current inputs, with all required entries checked. Generic query, node and export doors cannot disclose ownership CAS objects as accepted facts. Direct node resolution is not a bypass around projection/phase checks. Replay cannot apply or stage evaluation carriers into ordinary authority. Explicit evaluation output retains phase/generation/candidate labels; unavailable, drifted or unapproved state returns HOLD.

Consumer policy names a case and its frozen mode. A persistent per-candidate/generation/case ledger bounds index calls, read calls and delivered body bytes. Lock contention, stale partial budget files and exhaustion refuse rather than silently resetting. Consumer contexts receive questions and permitted reader access only, not source access, producer context or reserved answers. Mechanism tests do not establish that real consumer cases passed.

## Maintenance without promotion

Legacy v1 rebuild explicitly refuses v2. Evaluation rebuild has two stages: capture/plan/produce a complete private target, then receive two new exact target decisions and finalize a private v2 graph. Identical captured inputs/recipe return reuse with zero producer calls. A changed result requires fresh result-specific semantic evidence. Captured bytes and membership are checked before and after production; missing inputs/edges or stale reviews refuse.

A target may be materialized in a fresh isolated root. Target admission is a distinct lineage-checked route, not an exemption from the original native prepare equality check. It requires actual current source/runtime checks, preserved obligation identity and exact new decisions. Existing active state is not overwritten by bootstrap; operational activation is not provided. Recovery of interrupted/contended state must remain explicit and cannot return stale data as current.

## Final acceptance and evidence

All original AC, criterion matrix, frozen cases and DoD remain mandatory at their proper local/global scopes. Admission is neither an AC PASS nor final acceptance. Final evidence must separately include actual consumers, maintenance controls and required CI, evaluated by the required independent reviewers. A future accepted-phase publication requires a new exact candidate and separately authorized operational policy, not changing an evaluation flag in place.

Local actor strings and editable policy are not authenticated identity or protection against the same OS user rewriting code and all records. The implemented boundary is deterministic refusal through supported runtime doors, not an OS sandbox guarantee. CI fixtures and synthetic votes are test data only. Typecheck, generated-boundary verification, CI, candidate admission and campaign acceptance are separate results.

## Runtime coverage and operational doors

Runtime identity includes the adapter execution tree, package manifest, mandatory Atlas packages (contracts, genesis, grounding, index, kernel, knowledge, memory, persist, retrieval and tools), and their declared runtime dependency closure. Dependencies, present optional dependencies and peer dependencies are traversed package by package, not by scanning unrelated node_modules. An absent optional package is recorded explicitly; missing mandatory dependencies and conflicting resolved versions refuse. Resolved Atlas execution trees and complete external package files bind code and dynamically loaded assets, with node_modules traversed only through declarations. Engine versions are bound separately. This is coverage of the installed declared runtime, not a claim to authenticate the operating system or undeclared host executables.

Evaluation composition exposes only the bounded ownership reader and the guarded admission/check path. Other operational methods and tools, including link, reconciliation, promotion, memory and relation producers, refuse before execution. Special emit families cannot branch around evaluation authorization. Direct public assembler selection applies the same phase boundary. Generic CAS export/import and the UI surface explicitly refuse evaluation state or copied evaluation graphs/carriers, rather than dropping part of a bundle and reporting success. Legacy v1 bulk transfer remains distinct.

These are proposed acceptance obligations, NOT an executable suite or an observed red baseline.
Before production implementation, bind mechanical rows to real tests and record baseline results; bind
judged rows to frozen tasks, answer keys and an explicit evaluator. A pre-existing pass is regression
evidence, not a fabricated red→green claim. No new agent/model evaluation is authorized now.

| ID | Obligation and deciding evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-01 | **Coverage, judged + mechanical:** freeze the finite slice inventory: needs → required artifacts → sources → cases below. Every required need has accepted support; intentional unknowns are named in advance. Unknown critical required knowledge fails acceptance. Mechanical mapping completeness does not judge semantic sufficiency. |
| AC-02 | **Ownership, judged:** an Atlas-only consumer correctly handles a permitted change, contract violation, cross-component impact, operational failure and deliberately out-of-scope question. Freeze expected reasoning/consequences, critical mistakes and evidence before production. All required answers must match; the unknown case must abstain. The author alone cannot certify this row. |
| AC-03 | **Consumption, mixed:** skill states working protocol and index usage; actual index reads reach purpose, behavior, constraints, decisions, impact, verification and evidence within fixed task-specific read/context bounds. A routine task stops shallow; a deeper task reaches supporting knowledge. Each intermediate artifact has a direct-use case. Validate real readers, not only Markdown links. |
| AC-04 | **Construction, mixed:** real paths ingest existing knowledge and construct missing understanding; labelled stale/conflicting/missing/malicious-source fixtures are handled without inventing intent, hiding conflict, granting authority or publishing unsupported required content. A canned final document cannot satisfy the producer test. |
| AC-05 | **Reuse, mechanical:** identical inputs/recipe produce a cache hit with zero proposer calls; an independent edit preserves unrelated result identities and call counts. Equal prose with changed authority/validity/gaps MUST propagate; a receipt-only change refreshes bindings without new downstream interpretation. An unchanged validated consumer-visible result stops downstream rebuild. Build dependency edits invalidate dependents, unlike navigation-only links. |
| AC-06 | **Incremental correctness, mixed:** behavior edit, added/removed source, intent-doc change and recipe change produce the independently expected affected set. Rebuilds restore required knowledge; mutation controls omit an edge/input and must fail. Detecting staleness alone is insufficient. |
| AC-07 | **Publication/recovery, mechanical:** inject failure between generation and activation, interrupt/resume, and concurrent reads. A separate reader observes only a complete accepted manifest valid for current inputs/contracts or HOLD. A failed rebuild after source drift cannot fall back to stale knowledge as current. Resume reuses durable completions; rollback rejects incompatible source bindings; historical reads are labelled. |
| AC-08 | **Economy, mechanical + approval:** one run ledger/reservation governs production, evaluation, retries and concurrent calls. Synthetic checks precede real calls. If real adapter conformance requires a paid call, it needs a bounded explicit authorization first, charged to the same global envelope. Only a conforming route may run the real slice. Report limits, usage and unsettled calls; no bytes-to-token or call-count-to-dollar fiction. |
| AC-09 | **Git/CI/host, mechanical:** changed declared input, new input under registered scope, missing artifact, broken index reference, incompatible dependency version and invalid generation are rejected at intended gates/readers. A local invalid unit holds its required closure while an independent valid scope remains readable; shared manifest corruption holds its dependent reads. Known-good/bad controls use actual entry points. Report workflow scope and branch-protection enforcement separately. |
| AC-10 | **Preservation/migration, mechanical + review:** baseline inventory of protected campaign objects remains exact; old producers cannot publish into the new accepted scope accidentally. Stage new outputs without consumer authority, activate explicitly, preserve old accepted state for rollback and keep unrelated scopes usable. Generated boundaries change only through their generators. |

AC-02's oracle may inspect source/tests; the consumer cannot. Permit explicit product/owner sources in
the producer input; no hidden human rewriting of the answer. Prepare known-scope cases for regression and
separate held-out maintenance cases for evaluation, with their answer keys withheld from the producer.
Use owner evaluation or a separately authorized independent evaluator; self-review is not independence.
Semantic testing demonstrates the fixed cases, not universal correctness for arbitrary future tasks.

  evaluation: EvaluationOwnershipContract["evaluation"]; original_candidate: Hash; original_contract: Hash
  entries: (NativeCandidate["entries"][number] & { contract: Hash; semanticEvidence: Hash[] })[]
}
export type PreparedEvaluation = { schema: "genesis-native-prepared/v2"; candidate_id: Hash; candidate: EvaluationCandidate }
export function prepareEvaluation(repoPath: string, planPath: string): PreparedEvaluation {
  const root = nativeRoot(repoPath)
  const readReference = (value: unknown): { text: string; bytes: Uint8Array } => {
    const ref = nativeReference(value), bytes = readNativeFile(root, nativeReferencePath(ref))
    if (nativeSha256(bytes) !== ref.sha256) throw new Error("evaluation-reference-drift")
    return { text: decodeNativeUtf8(bytes), bytes }
  }
  const planBytes = readNativeFile(root, planPath)
  const plan = nativeRecord(JSON.parse(decodeNativeUtf8(planBytes)), "evaluation plan")
  nativeKeys(plan, ["schema", "package_path", "original_prepared", "obligations", "entries", "consumer_ids", "consumer_modes", "read_limits", "maintenance", "implementation", "isolation"], "evaluation plan")
  if (plan.schema !== "genesis-evaluation-plan/v1") throw new Error("evaluation-plan-version")
  const origin = JSON.parse(readReference(plan.original_prepared).text) as PreparedNativePackage
  if (origin.schema !== "genesis-native-prepared/v1" || origin.candidate_id !== id(origin.candidate)) throw new Error("evaluation-original-candidate")
  const isolation = nativeRecord(plan.isolation, "isolation")
  nativeKeys(isolation, ["root", "original_root"], "isolation")
  if (isolation.root !== root || isolation.original_root !== origin.candidate.repo_root || root === origin.candidate.repo_root || root.startsWith(origin.candidate.repo_root + "/") || origin.candidate.repo_root.startsWith(root + "/")) throw new Error("evaluation-isolation-root")
  if (existsSync(join(root, ".atlas/evaluation-store.json"))) loadEvaluationAccess(root).verify()
  else if (existsSync(join(root, ".atlas")) && readdirSync(join(root, ".atlas")).some((name) => name !== "cas")) throw new Error("evaluation-prepare-operational-state")
  const store = createDiskStore(nativeCasDirectory(root))
  const additional: NativeCandidate["observations"] = []
  const observeFile = (path: string, bytes: Uint8Array) => { const key = `file:${path}`, version = id({ kind: "ownership-source", version: 1, bytes: Array.from(bytes) }); additional.push({ key, version }) }
  const capture = (value: unknown) => { const ref = nativeReference(value), read = readReference(value); observeFile(nativeReferencePath(ref), read.bytes); return { text: read.text, body: nativePut(store, { kind: "ownership-body", version: 1, bytes: Array.from(read.bytes) }) } }
  observeFile(planPath, planBytes)
  capture(plan.original_prepared)
  const obligation = capture(plan.obligations)
  const obligations = nativeRecord(JSON.parse(obligation.text), "obligations")
  nativeKeys(obligations, ["schema", "original_candidate", "original_contract", "criteria", "normative_refs", "oracle_refs", "status"], "obligations")
  if (obligations.schema !== "genesis-obligation-set/v1" || obligations.original_candidate !== origin.candidate_id || obligations.original_contract !== origin.candidate.contract || obligations.status !== "PENDING_FINAL_EVIDENCE") throw new Error("evaluation-obligations")
  const criteria = nativeStrings(obligations.criteria, "final criteria")
  if (criteria.length !== origin.candidate.criteria.length || new Set(criteria).size !== criteria.length || !origin.candidate.criteria.every((x) => criteria.includes(x))) throw new Error("evaluation-final-criteria-preserved")
  for (const name of ["normative_refs", "oracle_refs"]) {
    if (!Array.isArray(obligations[name]) || obligations[name].length === 0) throw new Error("evaluation-final-evidence-refs")
    for (const ref of obligations[name]) capture(ref)
  }
  const base = prepareNativePackage(root, nativeText(plan.package_path, "package_path"))
  if (base.candidate.transport.sha256 !== origin.candidate.transport.sha256 || base.candidate.source_revision !== origin.candidate.source_revision) throw new Error("evaluation-package-drift")
  const consumers = nativeStrings(plan.consumer_ids, "consumer ids")
  if (!consumers.length || new Set(consumers).size !== consumers.length) throw new Error("evaluation-finite-consumers")
  const modes = nativeRecord(plan.consumer_modes, "consumer modes")
  if (Object.keys(modes).length !== consumers.length || consumers.some((key) => !["routine", "deep"].includes(String(modes[key])))) throw new Error("evaluation-consumer-modes")
  nativeRecord(plan.read_limits, "read limits")
  nativeRecord(plan.maintenance, "maintenance plan")
  const implementation = nativeRecord(plan.implementation, "implementation")
  if (Object.keys(implementation).length === 0) throw new Error("evaluation-implementation-missing")
  for (const [path, sha] of Object.entries(implementation)) { const bytes = readNativeFile(root, path); if (nativeSha256(bytes) !== sha) throw new Error("evaluation-implementation-drift"); observeFile(path, bytes) }
  const evaluation = { phase: "evaluation" as const, evaluationPlan: nativePut(store, plan), obligationSet: nativePut(store, obligations) }
  if (!Array.isArray(plan.entries) || plan.entries.length !== base.candidate.entries.length) throw new Error("evaluation-entry-coverage")
  const seen = new Set<string>()
  const entries = plan.entries.map((raw) => {
    const e = nativeRecord(raw, "entry")
    nativeKeys(e, ["key", "semantic_refs", "applicability", "limits"], "entry")
    const key = nativeText(e.key, "key"), entry = base.candidate.entries.find((x) => x.key === key)
    if (!entry || seen.has(key)) throw new Error("evaluation-entry-coverage")
    seen.add(key)
    if (!Array.isArray(e.semantic_refs) || e.semantic_refs.length < 2) throw new Error("evaluation-semantic-evidence")
    nativeText(e.applicability, "applicability"); nativeText(e.limits, "limits")
    const semanticEvidence = e.semantic_refs.map((ref) => capture(ref).body)
    const contract: EvaluationOwnershipContract = { kind: "ownership-contract", version: 2, criteria: [...OWNERSHIP_ADMISSION_CRITERIA], evaluation }
    return { ...entry, contract: nativePut(store, contract), semanticEvidence }
  })
  const { contract: _contract, criteria: _criteria, ...baseFields } = base.candidate
  for (const observation of additional) {
    const previous = baseFields.observations.find((x) => x.key === observation.key)
    if (previous !== undefined && previous.version !== observation.version) throw new Error("evaluation-conflicting-observations")
  }
  const observations = [...new Map([...baseFields.observations, ...additional].map((x) => [x.key, x])).values()]
  if (observations.some((x) => ownershipInput(root, x.key) !== x.version)) throw new Error("evaluation-preparation-drift")
  const candidate: EvaluationCandidate = { ...baseFields, observations, kind: "genesis-evaluation-candidate", version: 2, phase: "evaluation", plan_path: planPath,
    evaluation, runtime_identity: evaluationRuntimeIdentity(), original_candidate: origin.candidate_id, original_contract: origin.candidate.contract,
    implementation: { ...base.candidate.implementation, evaluation: nativeImplementation(import.meta.url), evaluationBinding: nativeImplementation(evaluationBindingUrl), evaluationPolicy: nativeImplementation(evaluationPolicyUrl) }, entries }
  return { schema: "genesis-native-prepared/v2", candidate_id: nativePut(store, candidate), candidate }
}
export async function admitEvaluation(repoPath: string, value: unknown, approvalPath: string) {
  const record = nativeRecord(value, "evaluation prepared")
  nativeKeys(record, ["schema", "candidate_id", "candidate"], "evaluation prepared")
  if (record.schema !== "genesis-native-prepared/v2") throw new Error("evaluation-prepared-schema")
  const previous = nativeRecord(record.candidate, "candidate")
  const fresh = prepareEvaluation(repoPath, nativeText(previous.plan_path, "plan_path"))
  if (record.candidate_id !== fresh.candidate_id || record.candidate_id !== id(previous) || JSON.stringify(previous) !== JSON.stringify(fresh.candidate)) throw new Error("evaluation-candidate-drift")
  return finishEvaluationAdmission(repoPath, fresh, approvalPath)
}
export async function admitEvaluationRebuildTarget(repoPath: string, value: unknown, approvalPath: string) {
  const root = nativeRoot(repoPath), store = createDiskStore(nativeCasDirectory(root))
  const record = nativeRecord(value, "target prepared")
  nativeKeys(record, ["schema", "candidate_id", "candidate"], "target prepared")
  if (record.schema !== "genesis-native-prepared/v2") throw new Error("evaluation-target-schema")
  const candidate = nativeRecord(record.candidate, "target candidate")
  if (candidate.kind !== "genesis-evaluation-candidate" || candidate.version !== 2 || candidate.phase !== "evaluation" || candidate.repo_root !== root ||
    record.candidate_id !== id(candidate) || JSON.stringify(store.get(record.candidate_id as Hash)) !== JSON.stringify(candidate) ||
    JSON.stringify(candidate.runtime_identity) !== JSON.stringify(evaluationRuntimeIdentity())) throw new Error("evaluation-target-identity")
  const evaluation = nativeRecord(candidate.evaluation, "target evaluation")
  const plan = nativeRecord(store.get(evaluation.evaluationPlan as Hash), "target plan")
  if (id(plan) !== evaluation.evaluationPlan || plan.schema !== "genesis-evaluation-rebuild-plan/v1") throw new Error("evaluation-target-plan")
  const baseline = nativeRecord(store.get(plan.baseline_candidate as Hash), "baseline candidate")
  const baselineManifest = nativeRecord(store.get(plan.baseline_manifest as Hash), "baseline manifest")
  if (baseline.kind !== "genesis-evaluation-candidate" || baseline.version !== 2 || baseline.phase !== "evaluation" || !isEvaluationOwnershipManifest(baselineManifest) || id(baseline) !== plan.baseline_candidate || id(baselineManifest) !== plan.baseline_manifest || baselineManifest.evaluationCandidate !== plan.baseline_candidate ||
    baseline.original_candidate !== candidate.original_candidate || baseline.original_contract !== candidate.original_contract || baseline.scope !== candidate.scope ||
    nativeRecord(baseline.evaluation, "baseline evaluation").obligationSet !== evaluation.obligationSet || nativeRecord(baseline.evaluation, "baseline evaluation").evaluationPlan !== plan.original_plan ||
    JSON.stringify(candidate.roots) !== JSON.stringify(baseline.roots) || JSON.stringify(candidate.required_artifact_keys) !== JSON.stringify(baseline.required_artifact_keys)) throw new Error("evaluation-target-lineage")
  if (!Array.isArray(candidate.entries) || !Array.isArray(baseline.entries) || candidate.entries.length !== baseline.entries.length) throw new Error("evaluation-target-entry-set")
  for (const raw of candidate.entries) {
    const entry = nativeRecord(raw, "target entry"), prior = baseline.entries.map((x) => nativeRecord(x, "baseline entry")).find((x) => x.key === entry.key)
    if (!prior) throw new Error("evaluation-target-entry-set")
    const artifact = nativeRecord(entry.artifact, "target artifact"), oldArtifact = nativeRecord(prior.artifact, "baseline artifact")
    for (const key of ["key", "scope", "title", "layer", "need", "navigation"]) if (JSON.stringify(artifact[key]) !== JSON.stringify(oldArtifact[key])) throw new Error("evaluation-target-metadata-drift")
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(candidate.observations) || candidate.observations.some((raw) => { const input = nativeRecord(raw, "input"); return typeof input.key !== "string" || ownershipInput(root, input.key) !== input.version })) throw new Error("evaluation-target-source-drift")
  const access = loadEvaluationAccess(root)
  if (access.context.generation !== plan.target_generation) throw new Error("evaluation-target-generation")
  if (store.loadProjection() !== undefined) throw new Error("evaluation-target-needs-fresh-store")
  return finishEvaluationAdmission(root, value as PreparedEvaluation, approvalPath)
}
async function finishEvaluationAdmission(repoPath: string, fresh: PreparedEvaluation, approvalPath: string) {
  const access = loadEvaluationAccess(repoPath)
  access.assert("admit")
  if (access.context.evaluationCandidate !== fresh.candidate_id || JSON.stringify(access.context.evaluation) !== JSON.stringify(fresh.candidate.evaluation) || access.scope !== fresh.candidate.scope) throw new Error("evaluation-policy-candidate")
  const root = fresh.candidate.repo_root, store = createDiskStore(nativeCasDirectory(root))
  const approval = JSON.parse(decodeNativeUtf8(readNativeFile(root, approvalPath)))
  const binding = validateEvaluationBinding(approval, fresh)
  const evidence = binding.decisions.map((decision) => [decision.request_ref, decision.response_ref].map((ref) => {
    const bytes = readNativeFile(root, nativeReferencePath(ref))
    if (nativeSha256(bytes) !== ref.sha256) throw new Error("evaluation-decision-reference-drift")
    return nativePut(store, { kind: "ownership-body", version: 1, bytes: Array.from(bytes) })
  }))
  const entries = fresh.candidate.entries.map((entry) => {
    const reviews = binding.decisions.map((decision, index) => {
      const review: EvaluationOwnershipReview = { kind: "ownership-review", version: 2, evaluation: fresh.candidate.evaluation, evaluationCandidate: fresh.candidate_id,
        reviewer: decision.reviewer, contract: entry.contract, inputs: entry.inputs_id, result: entry.artifact.result,
        criteria: [...OWNERSHIP_ADMISSION_CRITERIA], verdict: "pass", provenance: `New isolated admission only: ${decision.decision_id}; request/response ${evidence[index]!.join(" ")}` }
      return nativePut(store, review)
    })
    const receipt: EvaluationOwnershipReceipt = { kind: "ownership-receipt", version: 2, evaluation: fresh.candidate.evaluation, evaluationCandidate: fresh.candidate_id,
      contract: entry.contract, inputs: entry.inputs, dependencies: entry.dependencies, reviews }
    return { key: entry.key, artifact: nativePut(store, { ...entry.artifact, version: 2, evaluation: fresh.candidate.evaluation, evaluationCandidate: fresh.candidate_id, receipt: nativePut(store, receipt) }) }
  })
  const manifest: EvaluationOwnershipManifest = { kind: "ownership-manifest", version: 2, scope: fresh.candidate.scope, entries, roots: fresh.candidate.roots,
    evaluation: fresh.candidate.evaluation, evaluationCandidate: fresh.candidate_id, generation: access.context.generation }
  const ownership = nativePut(store, manifest)
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const result = readOwnership(store, ownership, { scope: manifest.scope, key: entry.key, maxBytes: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER }, (key) => ownershipInput(root, key), access.context)
    if (result.kind === "hold") return { kind: "hold" as const, phase: "evaluation", refusal: result }
  }
  const { composeRuntime } = await import("./compose.js")
  const { deriveGroundingAxes } = await import("./grounding-computer.js")
  const { walkFileTree } = await import("./fs.js")
  const { readScipOrEmpty } = await import("./scip.js")
  const axes = deriveGroundingAxes(walkFileTree(root), readScipOrEmpty(posix.join(root, ".atlas/index.scip"))).axes
  const node: GroundedFact = { kind: "advisory", id: asNodeKey(String(id({ ownership }))), tier: "T2", scope: manifest.scope,
    claimNorm: evaluationOwnershipClaim(manifest.scope, fresh.candidate_id), predicateSlot: "ownership", ownership,
    grounding: { entries: [{ anchor: { kind: "repo", qualifiedPath: axes.spatial.key, subtreeHash: axes.spatial.subtreeHash }, path: "." }] }, freshness: "FRESH", claims: [], authoring: "ADVISORY" }
  const runtime = composeRuntime(root, access), at = id({ kind: "evaluation-admission", candidate: fresh.candidate_id, generation: access.context.generation })
  const check = runtime.check(node, at)
  if (!check.wouldEmit) return { kind: "hold" as const, phase: "evaluation", check }
  access.assert("admit")
  return { kind: "evaluation-admission-attempt" as const, phase: "evaluation", candidate_id: fresh.candidate_id, ownership, generation: access.context.generation, check, emission: runtime.handler.handle("atlas-emit", { node, at }) }
}

export function validateEvaluationBinding(value: unknown, prepared: PreparedEvaluation): EvaluationBinding {
  const b = nativeRecord(value, "evaluation binding")
  nativeKeys(b, ["schema", "purpose", "candidate_id", "reviewers", "decisions"], "evaluation binding")

    if (d.decision_id !== `sha256:${response.sha256}` || responses.has(response.sha256)) throw new Error("evaluation-binding-provenance")
    responses.add(response.sha256)
    if (!Array.isArray(d.entries) || d.entries.length !== prepared.candidate.entries.length) throw new Error("evaluation-binding-coverage")

    for (const rawEntry of d.entries) {
      const e = nativeRecord(rawEntry, "entry")
      nativeKeys(e, ["key", "contract", "result", "inputs", "criteria"], "entry")

        const c = nativeRecord(rawCriterion, "criterion")
        nativeKeys(c, ["id", "verdict"], "criterion")
        if (c.verdict !== "PASS") throw new Error("evaluation-binding-criterion-hold")
        return nativeText(c.id, "criterion id")
      })

      kind: "ownership-artifact", version: 1, key: source.key, scope: pack.scope, title: source.title,
      layer: source.layer, need: source.need, result: nativePut(store, result), navigation: source.navigation,

  }

}
export async function publishNativePackage(repoPath: string, value: unknown, approvalPath: string) {
  const record = nativeRecord(value, "prepared record")
  if (record.schema !== "genesis-native-prepared/v1") throw new Error("native-prepared-schema")
  const candidate = nativeRecord(record.candidate, "candidate")
  const transport = nativeRecord(candidate.transport, "candidate.transport")

  if (record.candidate_id !== id(candidate) || record.candidate_id !== fresh.candidate_id || JSON.stringify(candidate) !== JSON.stringify(fresh.candidate))
    throw new Error("native-candidate-drift: prepare again and obtain new exact binding decisions")

  const store = createDiskStore(nativeCasDirectory(root))
  const approvalBytes = readNativeFile(root, nativePath(approvalPath))
  const binding = validateNativeBinding(JSON.parse(decodeNativeUtf8(approvalBytes)), fresh)
  const provenance = nativeBody(store, approvalBytes)
  const decisionBodies = binding.decisions.map((decision) => {
    const capture = (reference: NativeReference) => {
      const bytes = readNativeFile(root, nativeReferencePath(reference))
      if (nativeSha256(bytes) !== reference.sha256) throw new Error("native-binding-reference-drift")

    }

  })

        inputs: entry.inputs_id, result: entry.artifact.result, criteria: fresh.candidate.criteria, verdict: "pass",
        provenance: `Operator-supplied NEW runtime binding; decision ${decision.decision_id_kind} ${decision.decision_id}; candidate ${fresh.candidate_id}; preserved approval ${provenance}; request ${decisionBodies[index]!.request}; response ${decisionBodies[index]!.response}. This adapter record is not original reviewer prose.`,
      }
      return nativePut(store, review)
    })
    const receipt: OwnershipReceipt = { kind: "ownership-receipt", version: 1, contract: fresh.candidate.contract, inputs: entry.inputs, dependencies: entry.dependencies, reviews }
    return { key: entry.key, artifact: nativePut(store, { ...entry.artifact, receipt: nativePut(store, receipt) }) }
  })
  const manifest: OwnershipManifest = { kind: "ownership-manifest", version: 1, scope: fresh.candidate.scope, entries, roots: fresh.candidate.roots }
  const ownership = nativePut(store, manifest)
  // The existing attachment gate visits roots. Check every transported entry too, so a blocked or
  // unreviewed disconnected entry cannot hide behind a supported root.
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const read = readOwnership(store, ownership, { scope: manifest.scope, key: entry.key, maxBytes: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER }, (key) => ownershipInput(root, key))
    if (read.kind === "hold") return { kind: "hold" as const, stage: "ownership-validation", candidate_id: fresh.candidate_id, ownership, refusal: read }
  }
  const { composeRuntime } = await import("./compose.js")
  const { deriveGroundingAxes } = await import("./grounding-computer.js")
  const { walkFileTree } = await import("./fs.js")
  const { readScipOrEmpty } = await import("./scip.js")
  const axes = deriveGroundingAxes(walkFileTree(root), readScipOrEmpty(posix.join(root, ".atlas/index.scip"))).axes
  const node: GroundedFact = {
    kind: "advisory", id: asNodeKey(String(id({ ownership }))), tier: "T2", scope: manifest.scope,
    claimNorm: ownershipClaim(manifest.scope), predicateSlot: "ownership", ownership,
    grounding: { entries: [{ anchor: { kind: "repo", qualifiedPath: axes.spatial.key, subtreeHash: axes.spatial.subtreeHash }, path: "." }] },
    freshness: "FRESH", claims: [], authoring: "ADVISORY",
  }
  const at = id({ kind: "genesis-native-binding", candidate: fresh.candidate_id })
  const runtime = composeRuntime(root)
  const check = runtime.check(node, at)
  if (!check.wouldEmit) return { kind: "hold" as const, stage: "governed-check", candidate_id: fresh.candidate_id, ownership, check }
  const emission = runtime.handler.handle("atlas-emit", { node, at })
  return { kind: "publication-attempt" as const, candidate_id: fresh.candidate_id, ownership, at, check, emission }
}

function validateArtifact(value: unknown, scope: unknown) {
  const artifact = nativeRecord(value, "artifact")
  nativeKeys(artifact, ["key", "scope", "title", "layer", "need", "body", "authority", "validity", "gaps", "evidence", "input_keys", "source_refs", "recipe_ref", "build_dependencies", "navigation", "producer_request_ref", "producer_response_ref", "semantic_review_refs", "runtime_receipt_refs"], "artifact")
  for (const key of ["key", "scope", "title"]) nativeText(artifact[key], key)
  if (artifact.scope !== scope) throw new Error("native-artifact-scope")
  if (typeof artifact.layer !== "number" || ![1, 2, 3, 4].includes(artifact.layer) || !isOwnershipNeed(artifact.need)) throw new Error("native-layer-or-need")
  const body = nativeRecord(artifact.body, "body")
  nativeKeys(body, ["path", "encoding", "byte_length", "sha256"], "body")
  nativePath(body.path)
  if (body.encoding !== "utf-8" || !Number.isSafeInteger(body.byte_length) || Number(body.byte_length) < 1) throw new Error("native-body-encoding-or-length")
  nativeDigest(body.sha256, 64, "body.sha256")
  const authority = nativeRecord(artifact.authority, "authority")
  nativeKeys(authority, ["scope", "basis"], "authority")
  if (authority.scope !== scope) throw new Error("native-authority-scope")
  nativeText(authority.basis, "authority.basis")
  if (artifact.validity !== "supported" && artifact.validity !== "blocked") throw new Error("native-validity")
  nativeStrings(artifact.gaps, "gaps", false)
  nativeStrings(artifact.evidence, "evidence", false)
  const inputs = nativeStrings(artifact.input_keys, "input_keys")
  if (!inputs.length) throw new Error("native-empty-inputs")
  for (const key of inputs) {
    if (!key.startsWith("file:") && !key.startsWith("members:")) throw new Error(`native-input-key: ${key}`)
    nativePath(key.slice(key.indexOf(":") + 1))
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(artifact.source_refs) || !artifact.source_refs.length) throw new Error("native-empty-source-refs")
  const paths = artifact.source_refs.map((value) => {
    const ref = nativeRecord(value, "source_ref")
    nativeKeys(ref, ["commit", "path", "git_blob_sha", "sha256"], "source_ref")
    nativeDigest(ref.commit, 40, "source_ref.commit")
    nativeDigest(ref.git_blob_sha, 40, "source_ref.git_blob_sha")
    nativeDigest(ref.sha256, 64, "source_ref.sha256")
    const path = nativePath(ref.path)
    if (!inputs.includes(`file:${path}`)) throw new Error(`native-source-without-input: ${path}`)
    return path
  })
  if (new Set(paths).size !== paths.length) throw new Error("native-duplicate-source")
  const recipe = nativeReference(artifact.recipe_ref)
  if (!inputs.includes(`file:${nativeReferencePath(recipe)}`)) throw new Error("native-recipe-without-input")
  nativeReference(artifact.producer_request_ref)
  nativeReference(artifact.producer_response_ref)
  for (const key of ["semantic_review_refs", "runtime_receipt_refs"]) {

    if (!Array.isArray(values)) throw new Error(`native-reference-array: ${key}`)
    const refs = values.map((ref) => nativeReferenceKey(nativeReference(ref)))
    if (new Set(refs).size !== refs.length) throw new Error(`native-duplicate-reference: ${key}`)
    if (key === "semantic_review_refs" && refs.length < 2) throw new Error("native-semantic-review-evidence-missing")
  }
  nativeStrings(artifact.navigation, "navigation")
  if (!Array.isArray(artifact.build_dependencies)) throw new Error("native-build-dependencies")
  const dependencies = artifact.build_dependencies.map((value) => {
    const dependency = nativeRecord(value, "build_dependency")
    if (Object.hasOwn(dependency, "package_ref")) {
      nativeReference(dependency.package_ref)
      throw new Error("native-external-build-dependency-unsupported: existing ownership manifests resolve within one scope")
    }
    nativeKeys(dependency, ["key", "same_package"], "build_dependency")
    if (dependency.same_package !== true) throw new Error("native-dependency-kind")
    return nativeText(dependency.key, "dependency.key")
  })
  if (new Set(dependencies).size !== dependencies.length) throw new Error("native-duplicate-dependency")
}

export function readNativeFile(root: string, relative: string, maximum = nativeMaxBytes): Uint8Array {
  nativePath(relative)
  const parts = relative.split("/")
  const observed = parts.map((_, index) => {
    const path = resolve(root, ...parts.slice(0, index + 1))
    const stat = lstatSync(path)
    if (stat.isSymbolicLink() || (index < parts.length - 1 ? !stat.isDirectory() : !stat.isFile())) throw new Error(`native-file-kind: ${relative}`)
    return { path, stat }
  })
  const last = observed.at(-1)!
  if (last.stat.size > maximum) throw new Error(`native-file-limit: ${relative}`)
  const fd = openSync(last.path, constants.O_RDONLY | (constants.O_NOFOLLOW ?? 0) | (constants.O_NONBLOCK ?? 0))
  try {
    const before = fstatSync(fd)
    if (!before.isFile() || before.ino !== last.stat.ino || before.dev !== last.stat.dev || before.size > maximum) throw new Error(`native-file-changed: ${relative}`)
    const chunks: Buffer[] = []
    const buffer = Buffer.alloc(8192)
    let length = 0
    for (;;) {
      const count = readSync(fd, buffer, 0, buffer.length, null)
      if (!count) break
      length += count
      if (length > maximum) throw new Error(`native-file-limit: ${relative}`)
      chunks.push(Buffer.from(buffer.subarray(0, count)))
    }
    const after = fstatSync(fd)
    if (after.size !== before.size || after.mtimeMs !== before.mtimeMs || after.ctimeMs !== before.ctimeMs || length !== after.size)
      throw new Error(`native-file-changed: ${relative}`)
    for (const entry of observed) {
      const stat = lstatSync(entry.path)
      if (stat.isSymbolicLink() || stat.ino !== entry.stat.ino || stat.dev !== entry.stat.dev || stat.isDirectory() !== entry.stat.isDirectory())
        throw new Error(`native-file-changed: ${relative}`)
    }
    return Buffer.concat(chunks, length)
  } finally { closeSync(fd) }
}
export function decodeNativeUtf8(bytes: Uint8Array): string {

}
export function nativeBody(store: StoreApi, bytes: Uint8Array) {

export function nativePut(store: StoreApi, value: Parameters<StoreApi["put"]>[0]) {
  const hash = store.put(value)
  const persisted = hash ? store.get(hash) : undefined
  if (!hash || persisted === undefined || id(persisted) !== hash || hash !== id(value)) throw new Error("native-cas-write-failed")
  return hash
}
export function nativeCasDirectory(root: string): string {

    const stat = lstatSync(path)
    if (!stat.isDirectory() || stat.isSymbolicLink() || realpathSync(path) !== path) throw new Error(`native-state-path: ${relative}`)

export type NativeBinding = {

  candidate_id: string; contract: string; reviewers: string[]
  decisions: {
    reviewer: string; decision_id: string; decision_id_kind: "host-message" | "response-sha256"; purpose: "runtime-import-binding"

export function validateNativeBinding(value: unknown, prepared: PreparedNativePackage): NativeBinding {
  const binding = nativeRecord(value, "binding")
  nativeKeys(binding, ["schema", "purpose", "candidate_id", "contract", "reviewers", "decisions"], "binding")
  if (binding.schema !== "genesis-native-binding-approval/v1" || binding.purpose !== "runtime-import-binding") throw new Error("native-binding-purpose")

  const reviewers = nativeStrings(binding.reviewers, "binding.reviewers")
  if (reviewers.length !== 2) throw new Error("native-binding-two-reviewers")
  if (!Array.isArray(binding.decisions) || binding.decisions.length !== 2) throw new Error("native-binding-two-decisions")
  const seen = new Set<string>()
  const hostMessages = new Set<string>()
  const responses = new Set<string>()
  for (const value of binding.decisions) {
    const decision = nativeRecord(value, "binding decision")
    nativeKeys(decision, ["reviewer", "decision_id", "decision_id_kind", "purpose", "candidate_id", "contract", "verdict", "criteria", "entries", "request_ref", "response_ref"], "binding decision")
    const reviewer = nativeText(decision.reviewer, "reviewer")
    if (!reviewers.includes(reviewer) || seen.has(reviewer)) throw new Error("native-binding-reviewer")
    seen.add(reviewer)
    const decisionID = nativeText(decision.decision_id, "decision_id")
    if (decision.purpose !== "runtime-import-binding" || decision.verdict !== "PASS" || decision.candidate_id !== prepared.candidate_id || decision.contract !== prepared.candidate.contract)
      throw new Error("native-binding-exact-decision")
    nativeReference(decision.request_ref)
    const response = nativeReference(decision.response_ref)
    if (decision.decision_id_kind === "response-sha256") {
      if (decisionID !== `sha256:${response.sha256}`) throw new Error("native-binding-decision-digest")
    }
    if (decision.decision_id_kind === "host-message") {
      if (hostMessages.has(decisionID)) throw new Error("native-binding-duplicate-message")
      hostMessages.add(decisionID)
    }
    if (decision.decision_id_kind !== "response-sha256" && decision.decision_id_kind !== "host-message") throw new Error("native-binding-decision-id-kind")
    if (responses.has(nativeReferenceKey(response))) throw new Error("native-binding-duplicate-response")
    responses.add(nativeReferenceKey(response))
    if (!Array.isArray(decision.criteria) || decision.criteria.length !== prepared.candidate.criteria.length) throw new Error("native-binding-criteria")
    const criteria = decision.criteria.map((value) => {
      const criterion = nativeRecord(value, "binding criterion")
      nativeKeys(criterion, ["id", "verdict"], "binding criterion")
      if (criterion.verdict !== "PASS") throw new Error("native-binding-criterion-hold")
      return nativeText(criterion.id, "criterion.id")
    })
    if (new Set(criteria).size !== criteria.length || !prepared.candidate.criteria.every((criterion) => criteria.includes(criterion))) throw new Error("native-binding-criteria")
    if (!Array.isArray(decision.entries) || decision.entries.length !== prepared.candidate.entries.length) throw new Error("native-binding-entries")
    const keys = new Set<string>()
    for (const value of decision.entries) {
      const entry = nativeRecord(value, "binding entry")
      nativeKeys(entry, ["key", "result", "inputs"], "binding entry")
      const key = nativeText(entry.key, "binding entry.key")
      if (keys.has(key)) throw new Error("native-binding-duplicate-entry")
      keys.add(key)
      nativeDigest(entry.result, 64, "binding result")
      nativeDigest(entry.inputs, 64, "binding inputs")
      const expected = prepared.candidate.entries.find((entry) => entry.key === key)
      if (!expected || entry.result !== expected.artifact.result || entry.inputs !== expected.inputs_id) throw new Error(`native-binding-entry-drift: ${key}`)
    }
  }
  return value as NativeBinding

function load<T>(store: StoreApi, ref: Hash, matches: (value: unknown) => value is T): { value: T } | OwnershipRefusal {
  const value = store.get(ref)
  if (value === undefined) return hold("ownership-missing", [ref])
  if (!matches(value)) return hold("malformed-ownership", [ref])
  if (id(value) !== ref) return hold("ownership-integrity", [ref])
  return { value }
}
function hold(reason: OwnershipRefusal["reason"], evidence: readonly string[]): OwnershipRefusal {
  return { kind: "hold", reason, evidence }
}
function decode(bytes: readonly number[]): string | undefined {
  try {
    return new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true, ignoreBOM: true }).decode(new Uint8Array(bytes))
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }

function section(body: string, heading: string): string | undefined {
  const entries = headings(body)
  const starts = entries.flatMap((entry, index) => entry.depth === 2 && entry.text === heading ? [index] : [])
  if (starts.length !== 1) return undefined
  const start = starts[0]!
  return body.slice(entries[start]!.offset, entries[start + 1]?.offset)
}
function headings(body: string) {
  const state: { offset: number; fence?: string } = { offset: 0 }
  return body.split(/(?<=\n)/).flatMap((line) => {
    const offset = state.offset
    state.offset += line.length
    const fence = /^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})([^\r\n]*)/.exec(line)
    if (state.fence !== undefined) {
      if (fence && fence[1]![0] === state.fence[0] && fence[1]!.length >= state.fence.length && !fence[2]!.trim())
        delete state.fence
      return []
    }
    if (fence && !(fence[1]![0] === "`" && fence[2]!.includes("`"))) {
      state.fence = fence[1]!
      return []
    }
    const heading = /^ {0,3}(#{1,2})[\t ]+(.+?)(?:[\t ]+#+)?[\t ]*(?:\r?\n)?$/.exec(line)
    return heading ? [{ depth: heading[1]!.length, text: heading[2]!, offset }] : []
  })
}

const SIDE_INDEX: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["grounding", "status", "freshness"])
const UTF8 = new TextEncoder()
function serialize(v: unknown): string {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return "null"
  switch (typeof v) {
    case "boolean":
      return v ? "true" : "false"
    case "number":
      if (!Number.isFinite(v) || !Number.isInteger(v)) {
        throw new Error("canonical-form violation: floats forbidden (non-integer/non-finite number)")
      }
      return String(v)
    case "string":
      // NFC + one fixed escape policy (JSON string escaping).
      return JSON.stringify(v.normalize("NFC"))
    case "object": {
      if (Array.isArray(v)) return `[${v.map(serialize).join(",")}]`
      const o = v as Record<string, unknown>
      // Side-indexes (KERNEL-8) and `undefined`-valued keys are dropped FIRST: a key that never reaches the
      // preimage cannot collide in it, so the guard below prices only keys that are actually serialized.
      const present = Object.keys(o).filter((k) => !SIDE_INDEX.has(k) && o[k] !== undefined)
      // FAIL-CLOSED on an NFC key collision (KERNEL-1; functional-surface.md "a fact's canonical preimage
      // has a … key-order … divergence ⇒ fail-closed reject … never emit two CAS objects for one fact").
      //
      // Why this is a TOOTH and not defence-in-depth. `Object.keys` returns DISTINCT strings, but NFC is not
      // injective, so two distinct JS keys can normalize to one. Without this guard both survive into
      // `entries`, the sort comparator returns 0 for the pair, and V8's stable sort therefore preserves their
      // INSERTION order — emitting a duplicate-key preimage whose byte order depends on how the object was
      // built. MEASURED on the base commit: `{}` filled "café"(NFC)→1 then "café"(NFD)→2 hashed
      // bcee1c10…, and the same logical object filled in the other order hashed a065e84a… . Two digests for
      // one logical value is a canonicalizer that is not canonical, and it is the exact "two CAS objects for
      // one fact" fork KERNEL-1 forbids — reached from the opposite direction to the float/escape splits.
      //
      // Rejecting (rather than picking a winner) is the spec's mandated disposition and the only sound one:
      // the two keys are genuinely different data, so any tie-break would SILENTLY DISCARD one field.
      // Throwing makes the order-dependent preimage UNREACHABLE rather than merely unlikely.
      const seen = new Set<string>()
      const entries: (readonly [string, unknown])[] = []
      for (const k of present) {
        const nk = k.normalize("NFC")
        if (seen.has(nk)) {
          throw new Error(
            `canonical-form violation: NFC key collision on ${JSON.stringify(nk)} — two distinct keys ` +
              "normalize to one, so the preimage would depend on insertion order",
          )
        }
        seen.add(nk)
        entries.push([nk, o[k]] as const)
      }
      // Every key is now distinct, so the comparator never returns 0 and the order is total — the sorted
      // preimage is a function of the key SET alone, independent of `Object.keys` enumeration order.
      entries.sort((a, b) => (a[0] < b[0] ? -1 : a[0] > b[0] ? 1 : 0))
      return `{${entries.map(([k, val]) => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${serialize(val)}`).join(",")}}`
    }
    default:
      // bigint / symbol / function are not JSON — a canonical-form violation.
      throw new Error(`canonical-form violation: unsupported value type ${typeof v}`)
  }
}
export function canonicalForm(obj: CasObject): Uint8Array {
  return UTF8.encode(serialize(obj))
}
export function id(obj: CasObject): Hash {
  return defaultEncoder.hash(canonicalForm(obj))
}

export function constrainEvaluationRuntime(runtime: ComposedRuntime, repoPath: string, evaluation?: EvaluationAccess): ComposedRuntime {
  if (evaluation === undefined) return runtime
  // Evaluation grants only its budgeted ownership port and governed admission/check path.
  // Future operational methods are denied by default, not silently inherited by evaluation consumers.
  const facade = Object.create(null) as ComposedRuntime
  Object.defineProperties(facade, {
    ownership: { enumerable: true, get: () => { assertEvaluationComposition(repoPath, evaluation); return runtime.ownership } },
    handler: { enumerable: true, get: () => { assertEvaluationComposition(repoPath, evaluation); return runtime.handler } },
    check: { enumerable: true, get: () => (...args: Parameters<ComposedRuntime["check"]>) => {
      assertEvaluationComposition(repoPath, evaluation)
      evaluation.assert("admit")
      return runtime.check(...args)
    } },
  })
  Object.preventExtensions(facade)
  return new Proxy(facade, {
    get(target, property, receiver) {
      if (!Object.hasOwn(target, property)) throw new Error("evaluation-operation-denied")
      return Reflect.get(target, property, receiver)
    },
    set() { throw new Error("evaluation-operation-denied") },
    defineProperty() { throw new Error("evaluation-operation-denied") },
    deleteProperty() { throw new Error("evaluation-operation-denied") },
    setPrototypeOf() { throw new Error("evaluation-operation-denied") },
  })
}

export function assertOperationalStateDirectory(directory: string): void {
  const paths = new Set([resolve(directory)])
  if (existsSync(directory)) paths.add(realpathSync(directory))
  for (const origin of [...paths]) {
    let parent = origin
    while (dirname(parent) !== parent) {
      if (basename(parent) === ".atlas") { paths.add(parent); break }
      parent = dirname(parent)
    }

  // Ordinary new stores may not have materialized CAS yet. Never accept dangling aliases.
  try { lstatSync(path) } catch (error) {
    if (typeof error === "object" && error !== null && "code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT") return undefined
    throw error
  }

  if (dirname(cas) !== actualState) throw new Error("evaluation-store-directory-split")

    if (existsSync(path)) assertOperationalStateDirectory(dirname(realpathSync(path)))

   *  oracle a second time. `undefined` for `trusted` (never run — the whole point of paying no new cost) and

export function trackedProvableAdvisory(report: ReverifyReport): string {

  const served = report.reProven

function buildProvable(
  casPath: CasPath,
  headSha: () => string | undefined,
  gatedStore: DiskStore,
  verifyFactLeg: VerifyFactLeg,
  docExists: DocExists,
  scopeHasDocs: ScopeHasDocs,
  replay: TestVacuityReplay | undefined,
): { readonly store: DiskStore; readonly report: ReverifyReport } | undefined {
  try {
    // NO trust seam ⇒ never consulted ⇒ reads the raw file regardless of git status (`store.ts`'s own
    // documented "absent" behaviour) — the one place this module deliberately steps around the write-gate,
    // for READS only; `gatedStore` (still trust-gated) is what every WRITE continues to ride, unchanged.
    const raw = createDiskStore(casPath, headSha)
    const rawCurrent = currentNodes(rehydrateProjection(raw))
    // PAIRED, not two independently-filtered arrays — a node whose CAS bytes are missing (a miss ⇒
    // `undefined`) drops from BOTH `rows`/`reProven*` together, never leaving the two lists silently
    // misaligned the way two separate `.filter()` calls over the same source could.
    const pairs: { readonly node: CurrentNode; readonly fact: GroundedFact }[] = []
    // A `seal:'proven'` node whose bytes are GONE is collected, not discarded. This path and
    // `reverifyStore`'s both used to drop it silently, and on a store with 17 such rows `atlas verify-store`
    // printed "0 sealed-proven fact(s) — nothing to re-verify (an honest zero, not a skip)". The seal is on
    // the projection row, so no bytes are needed to know the row should have been counted.
    const dangling: CurrentNode[] = []
    for (const node of rawCurrent) {
      const fact = raw.get(node.contentHash as Hash) as GroundedFact | undefined
      if (fact !== undefined) pairs.push({ node, fact })
      else if ((node as { readonly seal?: string }).seal === "proven") dangling.push(node)
    }
    // `replay` threaded so a `seal:'proven'` test-vacuity RE-PROVES against HEAD here (over the ONE shared
    // `testUnitsOf(rawTree, axes)` feed compose built before `buildReadAccess`) instead of falling to
    // `unverifiable` for want of a re-scan leg — the over-refusal (#249) this closes. Fail-safe either way
    // (a still-vacuous fact was DROPPED, never served stale-as-fresh); this stops dropping the honest ones.
    const rows = pairs.map((p) => reverifyFact(p.node, p.fact, verifyFactLeg, docExists, scopeHasDocs, replay))
    const sealedProven = rows.filter((r): r is NonNullable<typeof r> => r !== undefined)
    // The dangling rows are appended to the REPORT only — never to `rows`, whose index must stay aligned with
    // `pairs` for the re-proven bookkeeping below.
    const reportRows = [...sealedProven, ...dangling.map(danglingRow)]
    const report: ReverifyReport = {
      sealedProven: reportRows.length,
      reProven: sealedProven.filter((r) => r.outcome === "re-proven").length,
      broken: sealedProven.filter((r) => r.outcome === "broken").length,
      unverifiable: sealedProven.filter((r) => r.outcome === "unverifiable").length,
      dangling: dangling.length,
      rows: reportRows,
    }
    const reProvenNodeKeys = new Set<string>()
    const reProvenContentHashes = new Set<Hash>()
    for (let i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
      if (rows[i]?.outcome === "re-proven") {
        reProvenNodeKeys.add(pairs[i]!.node.nodeKey)
        reProvenContentHashes.add(pairs[i]!.node.contentHash as Hash)
      }
    }
    const filtered: DiskStore = {
      ...gatedStore, // writes still refuse via the properly gated store if ever invoked (defence in depth)
      get: (h: Hash) => (reProvenContentHashes.has(h) ? raw.get(h) : undefined),
      loadProjection: () => {
        const proj = raw.loadProjection()
        if (proj === undefined) return undefined
        const current = new Map([...proj.current].filter(([k]) => reProvenNodeKeys.has(k)))
        return { ...proj, current }
      },
    }
    return { store: filtered, report }
  } catch {
    return undefined // fail-closed: the caller refuses rather than serving raw or gated-empty rows
  }
}
export function buildReadAccess(opts: {
  readonly provenance: () => StoreProvenance
  readonly casPath: CasPath
  readonly headSha: () => string | undefined
  readonly gatedStore: DiskStore
  readonly verifyFactLeg: VerifyFactLeg
  readonly docExists: DocExists
  readonly scopeHasDocs: ScopeHasDocs
  /** The Wave-3 test-vacuity reverify replay (the ONE shared `testUnitsOf` feed's leg), threaded so a proven
   *  test-vacuity RE-PROVES during the `tracked-provable` serve filter rather than dropping to `unverifiable`
   *  (over-refusal, #249). `undefined` degrades to the pre-Wave-3 behaviour (test-vacuities `unverifiable`,
   *  dropped) — fail-safe, never a false re-prove. Consumed ONLY on the `tracked-provable` leg. */
  readonly replay?: TestVacuityReplay
}): ReadAccess {
  const kind = opts.provenance()
  if (kind === "trusted") {
    // CASE 1 — no new cost: the gated store IS the read store, no raw re-read, no reverify pass.
    return { store: opts.gatedStore, refusal: undefined, reverified: undefined }
  }
  if (kind === "tracked-staging") {
    // CASE 3 — flat refusal, unchanged in kind: staging carries no replayable witness by construction.
    return { store: opts.gatedStore, refusal: REJECTED_UNTRUSTED_STORE, reverified: undefined }
  }
  // CASE 2 — tracked-provable: served, filtered to what re-proves; fail-closed if re-verification cannot run.
  const built = buildProvable(
    opts.casPath,
    opts.headSha,
    opts.gatedStore,
    opts.verifyFactLeg,
    opts.docExists,
    opts.scopeHasDocs,
    opts.replay,
  )
  if (built === undefined) {
    return { store: opts.gatedStore, refusal: REJECTED_UNTRUSTED_STORE, reverified: undefined }
  }
  return { store: built.store, refusal: undefined, reverified: built.report }
}

  const reads = seats.dirs.map((dir) => {
    const files = jsonlFiles(join(membersDir(repoPath), dir, "knowledge"))
    const read = readDurableLogs(files.paths)
    const events = [...read.log.values()]
    const entries = events.flatMap((ev) => {
      const entry = ev.payload
      return isEntry(entry) && segment(entry.seat) === dir && entry.row.nodeKey === ev.nodeKey ? [entry] : []
    })
    return { entries, rejected: read.rejected + events.length - entries.length, unreadable: files.unreadable ?? read.unreadable }
  })
  const rows = new Map<string, KnowledgeEntry>()
  reads.flatMap((r) => r.entries).forEach((entry) => {
    const prior = rows.get(entry.row.nodeKey)
    if (prior === undefined || later(entry, prior)) rows.set(entry.row.nodeKey, entry)
  })
  const rejected = reads.reduce((n, r) => n + r.rejected, 0)
  return seats.unreadable === true || reads.some((r) => r.unreadable === true) ? { rows, rejected, unreadable: true } : { rows, rejected }
}
export function withKnowledgeLog(
  store: DiskStore,
  opts: { readonly repoPath: string; readonly seat: string; readonly source?: KnowledgeSource; readonly now?: () => string; readonly evaluation?: EvaluationAccess },
): DiskStore {
  // The card and attempt come from the host, through `ATLAS_CARD` and `ATLAS_ATTEMPT`, unless the caller names them.
  const source = opts.source ?? {
    ...(process.env.ATLAS_CARD === undefined ? {} : { card: process.env.ATLAS_CARD }),
    ...(process.env.ATLAS_ATTEMPT === undefined ? {} : { attempt: process.env.ATLAS_ATTEMPT }),
  }
  return {
    ...store,
    commitProjection(decide) {
      const checkPhase = () => {
        if (opts.evaluation === undefined) assertOperationalDiskStore(store)
        else { assertEvaluationComposition(opts.repoPath, opts.evaluation); opts.evaluation.assert("admit"); assertEvaluationDiskStore(store, opts.evaluation.root) }
      }
      checkPhase()
      const seen: { before?: StoreProjection; next?: StoreProjection | undefined } = {}
      const result = store.commitProjection((projection) => {
        checkPhase()
        const decision = decide(projection)
        seen.before = projection
        seen.next = decision.next
        return decision
      })
      if (!result.settled || seen.before === undefined || seen.next === undefined) return result
      const before = seen.before
      const at = (opts.now ?? (() => new Date().toISOString()))()
      ;[...seen.next.current.values()]
        .filter((row) => JSON.stringify(before.current.get(row.nodeKey)) !== JSON.stringify(row))
        .forEach((row) =>
          appendKnowledge(opts.repoPath, { seat: opts.seat, row, at, source }, store.get(row.contentHash as Hash), opts.evaluation),
        )
      return result
    },
  }
}
const later = (a: KnowledgeEntry, b: KnowledgeEntry): boolean =>
  a.at !== b.at ? a.at > b.at : a.row.contentHash > b.row.contentHash
function seatDirs(dir: string): { readonly dirs: readonly string[]; readonly unreadable?: true } {
  try {
    return {
      dirs: readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })
        .filter((e) => e.isDirectory())
        .map((e) => e.name)
        .sort(),
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if ((e as { code?: unknown } | null)?.code === "ENOENT") return { dirs: [] }
    return { dirs: [], unreadable: true }
  }
}
const isText = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === "string" && v.length > 0
function isEntry(v: unknown): v is KnowledgeEntry {
  if (v === null || typeof v !== "object") return false
  const o = v as Record<string, unknown>
  const row = o.row as Partial<CurrentNode> | null | undefined
  if (typeof o.seat !== "string" || !isText(o.at) || o.source === null || typeof o.source !== "object") return false
  return row !== null && typeof row === "object" && isText(row.nodeKey) && isText(row.contentHash)
}

  readonly rejected: number

export function replayKnowledge(
  repoPath: string,
  disk: DiskStore,
  policy: AtlasPolicy,
  reproven: (node: CurrentNode, fact: GroundedFact) => boolean,
): KnowledgeReplay {
  assertOperationalStateDirectory(join(repoPath, ".atlas"))
  assertOperationalDiskStore(disk)
  const read = readKnowledge(repoPath)
  const projection = rehydrateProjection(disk)
  const pending = [...read.rows.values()].filter(
    (e) => !sameRow(projection.current.get(e.row.nodeKey), e.row),
  )
  const resolved = pending.filter((e) => restoreBlob(repoPath, disk, e) && genericOwnershipVisible(disk.get(e.row.contentHash as Hash)))
  const proven = resolved.filter((e) => {
    const fact = disk.get(e.row.contentHash as Hash) as GroundedFact
    return fact.seal === "proven" && actorInScope(policy, e.seat, e.row.scope) && reproven(e.row, fact)
  })
  const candidates = resolved.filter((e) => !proven.includes(e))
  const applied = proven.length === 0 ? undefined : disk.commitProjection((p) => ({ out: proven.length, next: withRows(p, proven) }))
  const staged =
    candidates.length === 0
      ? undefined
      : disk.commitStaging((p) => {
          const fresh = candidates.filter((e) => p.current.get(e.row.nodeKey)?.contentHash !== e.row.contentHash)
          return fresh.length === 0 ? { out: 0 } : { out: fresh.length, next: withRows(p, fresh) }
        })
  const refusal = [applied, staged].flatMap((r) => (r !== undefined && !r.settled ? [r.refusal] : []))[0]
  const counts = {
    applied: applied?.settled === true ? applied.out : 0,
    staged: staged?.settled === true ? staged.out : 0,
    missing: pending.length - resolved.length,
    rejected: read.rejected,
    ...(read.unreadable === true ? { unreadable: true as const } : {}),
  }
  const result = refusal === undefined ? counts : { ...counts, refusal }
  // Stderr only, so a command's stdout stays its answer; silent when nothing happened.
  if (counts.applied + counts.staged + counts.missing + counts.rejected > 0 || read.unreadable === true || refusal !== undefined)
    console.error(`atlas: knowledge replay ${JSON.stringify(result)}`)
  return result
}
function restoreBlob(repoPath: string, disk: DiskStore, entry: KnowledgeEntry): boolean {
  const hash = entry.row.contentHash as Hash
  if (disk.get(hash) !== undefined) return true
  try {
    return disk.put(JSON.parse(readFileSync(blobPath(repoPath, hash), "utf8")) as CasObject) === hash
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}
function sameRow(held: CurrentNode | undefined, logged: CurrentNode): boolean {
  if (held === undefined) return false
  const { derivedAt: _held, ...heldRest } = held
  const { derivedAt: _logged, ...loggedRest } = logged
  return JSON.stringify(heldRest) === JSON.stringify(loggedRest)
}
const withRows = (p: StoreProjection, entries: readonly KnowledgeEntry[]): StoreProjection => ({
  ...p,
  current: new Map([...p.current, ...entries.map((e) => [e.row.nodeKey, e.row] as const)]),
  cas: new Set([...p.cas, ...entries.map((e) => e.row.contentHash)]),
})

    entry.row.claims.length === 0 || entry.row.claims.some((claim) => !claim.startsWith("Evaluation-only ownership manifest for "))))
    throw new Error("evaluation-operational-replay-refused")
}

function committedSnapshot(repoPath: string): OwnSnapshot | undefined | "malformed" {

function blobsAt(repoPath: string, head: string, unit: string): Record<string, string> {
  const entries = runGit(repoPath, ["ls-tree", "-r", "-z", head, "--", unit])
    .split("\0")
    .filter((line) => line !== "")
    .map((line) => {
      const tab = line.indexOf("\t")
      const meta = line.slice(0, tab).split(" ")
      return { mode: meta[0] ?? "", type: meta[1] ?? "", blob: meta[2] ?? "", path: line.slice(tab + 1) }
    })
  return Object.fromEntries(
    entries
      .filter((entry) => entry.type === "blob" && entry.mode !== "120000" && !entry.path.split("/").includes(".atlas"))
      .map((entry) => [entry.path, entry.blob]),
  )
}

  }

export function isEvaluationPayload(value: unknown): boolean {
  const pending: unknown[] = [value]
  const seen = new Set<object>()
  while (pending.length > 0) {
    const next = pending.pop()
    if (typeof next === "string") {
      if (next.startsWith("Evaluation-only ownership manifest for ")) return true
      continue
    }
    if (next === null || typeof next !== "object" || seen.has(next)) continue
    seen.add(next)
    if (Array.isArray(next)) { pending.push(...next); continue }
    const record = next as Record<string, unknown>
    if ("evaluation" in record || "evaluationCandidate" in record || record.phase === "evaluation" ||
      (typeof record.kind === "string" && record.kind.startsWith("genesis-evaluation-")) ||
      (typeof record.schema === "string" && (record.schema.startsWith("genesis-evaluation-") || record.schema.startsWith("ownership-evaluation-"))) ||
      (record.version === 2 && typeof record.kind === "string" && record.kind.startsWith("ownership-"))) return true
    pending.push(...Object.values(record))
  }
  return false
}

export function readCas(casPath: string): Cas {
  assertOperationalCas(casPath)
  const store = createDiskStore(casPath)
  const cas: Cas = new Map<Hash, CasObject>()

  try {
    shards = readdirSync(casPath, { withFileTypes: true })
      .filter((e) => e.isDirectory())
      .map((e) => e.name)
  } catch {
    return cas
  }
  for (const shard of shards) {
    let files: string[]
    try {
      files = readdirSync(join(casPath, shard), { withFileTypes: true })
        .filter((e) => e.isFile())
        .map((e) => e.name)

      if (isEvaluationPayload(obj)) throw new Error("evaluation-operational-export-refused")
      if (obj !== undefined) cas.set(name as Hash, obj)
    }
  }
  assertOperationalCas(casPath)
  return cas
}
export function writeCasObjects(cas: Cas, casPath: string): number {
  assertOperationalCas(casPath)
  // Complete preflight before creating directories or writing even the first object.
  for (const obj of cas.values()) if (isEvaluationPayload(obj)) throw new Error("evaluation-operational-import-refused")

  mkdirSync(casPath, { recursive: true })
  let n = 0
  for (const obj of cas.values()) {
    store.put(obj)
    n += 1
  }
  return n
}

    const w = b.get(k)
    if (w === undefined || JSON.stringify(v) !== JSON.stringify(w)) return false
  }
  return true
